title: Release
description: One release to an environment, stored in `docs/releases/<environment>-<yyyy-mm-dd>-<n>.md`. Run `aidd new release <environment> --commit <sha>` to write one. Never edit it in place to roll back; write a newer release file instead.

environment.description: The environment this release landed in, naming one entry in `environments` of `.aidd/config.yaml`.

released_at.description: When users had this release (RFC 3339). Releases of one environment are ordered by this time.

commit.description: The commit running in this environment now, as lowercase hexadecimal characters.

specs.description: Specs that are new in this release: held by `commit` and not by the environment's earlier live commit.

rolled_back.description: Specs an earlier release of this environment held that this release no longer holds, or that a flag rollback turned off.
